suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-14 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. A large cohort of adults with isolated mandible fracture documented subsequent mandibular malunion/nonunion; because the catalog primary is broader than the evidence, the approved relationship applies only when the maxillofacial fracture specifically involves the mandible. Apply the broader maxillofacial-fracture identity only when the documented fracture specifically involves the mandible. Require separately established mandibular nonunion after that fracture. Do not infer mandibular nonunion from another facial fracture or from uncomplicated fracture healing. Preserve open-fracture status, infection, diabetes, alcohol use, treatment delay or fixation problems, osteonecrosis, metabolic bone disease, and other causes as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
